kind: collection failure and probe correction; not a performance failure
cause: At the fixed 120-column width, the longer two-digit fixture directory made the first actual editor echo wrap to the physical row immediately after the prompt. The probe required both on one row.
correction: Accept the exact first key on the prompt row or its immediately following physical row. Reject empty prompts, unrelated prompts, blank intervening rows and candidate/menu text.

replacement: independent batch required with a newly frozen clean release probe
